events.text: A friend gives you a gift: an expensive sword. It is very clearly a sword for a much taller person.

effects.log: You hang it on the wall. Every time they visit, they beam at it.

choices.text: Trade it for one that fits

effects.log: The smith exchanges it. Your friend never knows. Probably.

events.text: A quiet day fishing on the river. Nothing bites.

effects.log: Still nothing. The quiet is the catch.
The fish flee in terror. You are very refreshed.

events.text: Night falls on a mountain pass. Wolves are howling, and your fire is small.

choices.text: Keep the fire high all night

effects.log: No sleep, no wolves.

ok.log: You sleep. The wolves pass beneath you.

fail.log: You fall asleep and nearly fall out.

events.text: The rope bridge you are crossing snaps a strand. It sags beneath you.

ok.log: You make it as the bridge falls behind you.

fail.log: It drops. You cling to the cliff and climb up, torn and shaking.

effects.log: Slow, careful, alive. You find another way.

events.text: Crossing a frozen lake, the ice cracks under you.

ok.log: You reach the shore, soaked to the knee.

fail.log: You fall through. You pull yourself out, frozen.

effects.log: The ice breaks behind every step. You make it.

events.text: A friendly spar goes wrong. Your partner's blade slips and cuts deep.

effects.log: A month of stiffness. Your partner visits every day, guilty.

choices.text: Laugh it off and keep training

effects.log: The wound heals slowly. Your partner learns to be careful.

events.text: A snake has found its way into your bedding.

ok.log: Out the window, both of you calm.

fail.log: It bites. You spend a week with a swollen hand.

effects.log: Two hours awake, staring at a snake. It leaves at dawn.

events.text: You sneeze in the middle of a formal ceremony. The whole hall turns around.

effects.log: Somehow it becomes part of the ceremony.
Everyone knows it was you.

events.text: Your sword gets stuck in its scabbard just when you want to show it off.

effects.log: Everyone laughs with you.
It comes out and flies across the room.

events.text: A fortune-teller tells you that you will meet a tall stranger. You meet a very short one.

effects.log: She says the stranger is tall on the inside.
A good friend for a year.

events.text: You drop your sword in front of a crowd during a demonstration.

choices.text: Bow as if it was part of the act

effects.log: They applaud. Some are not sure.
The crowd laughs with you.

events.text: You try to disguise yourself to avoid a boring party. Everyone recognises you.

effects.log: Everyone plays along. It becomes the best party.
They are disappointed.

events.text: A flock of ducks blocks the road and refuses to move.

effects.log: An hour later they move. All together. Very dignified.
You are now a duck herder for an afternoon.

events.text: You are mistaken for a ghost walking home late in white robes.

effects.log: The story is told for years.
They do not believe you.

events.text: You have been standing in the rain for six hours, staring at a single falling leaf, because you are almost sure it moves like a sword technique.

ok.log: You figure it out as the sun sets. You catch a cold. It is worth it.

fail.log: It was just a leaf. You catch a cold anyway.

choices.text: Go inside like a normal person

effects.log: You go inside. You think about the leaf all through dinner. Your friends have stopped asking.

events.text: A letter arrives from a hermit you met long ago. It contains a single sentence of advice.

effects.log: 'Breathe from the feet.' It helps.
He does not reply. Hermits.

events.text: An orphan you once helped gives you a carved wooden bird.

effects.log: You carry it for the rest of your life.
Yours is worse. They love it.

events.text: Snow covers the training yard.

effects.log: Cold makes you sharp.
Clean ground, clean mind.

events.text: A ragged youth follows you for three days, copying your stance.

effects.log: They beam and vanish into the crowd.
Someday they may be someone.

events.text: You practise calligraphy for a month.

effects.log: It looks like a sword. Almost.
It looks peaceful. Almost.

events.text: You meet an old acquaintance on a bridge by chance.

effects.log: Old times, new stories.
The bridge becomes a long walk.

events.text: An owl hoots on your roof three nights in a row.

effects.log: Owls hoot.
The owl is pleased.

events.text: The roadside shrine is overgrown.

effects.log: A small good deed.
For the traveller's god.

events.text: A crow follows you for three days, cawing every time you make a mistake.

effects.log: It brings you shiny things. You are not sure where from.
You are more careful. The crow seems satisfied.

events.text: Everything goes wrong today. You trip, spill, and lose a sandal.

effects.log: By evening it is the funniest day of the year.
Tomorrow is a new day.

events.text: A letter arrives for someone with a similar name. It is a love letter.

choices.text: Deliver it to the right person

effects.log: Two people are very happy. One is very embarrassed.

choices.text: Return it to the post house

effects.log: Proper. Boring. Correct.

events.text: You start a small herb garden behind your house.

effects.log: Ginger, mint, and something the old women swear by.
The bees are delighted.

events.text: A fever keeps you in bed for a week.

effects.log: You recover slowly.
You recover faster and weaker.

events.text: A mountain hermitage offers bed and board in return for a month of work.

effects.log: Chopping wood, carrying water, sitting still.
A good night and a good breakfast.

events.text: You shelter from rain under a tree with a stranger who has the same umbrella as you.

effects.log: A fine hour. You never learn their name.
Dried plums for dried meat. A fair trade.

events.text: An old man sits alone by the bridge every day.

effects.log: He tells you about his life. It was a big one.
He smiles for the first time in weeks.

events.text: Friends plan a picnic on the mountain.

effects.log: The heaviest basket, the best view.
Everyone laughs until sunset.

events.text: An herbalist offers a tea that she says makes you wiser.

effects.log: It tastes like a wet forest. You feel no wiser.
A long list. You learn a lot.

events.text: You start keeping a journal of your training.

effects.log: Patterns appear. You improve faster.
A book of stances.

events.text: {npc} turns up at your door with a jar of wine and two cups. 'I was passing,' {he} says. Nobody passes your door.

effects.log: You talk about everything and nothing. {He} drinks, you keep to tea, and by morning you have a friend.

choices.text: Thank {him}, but you need to train

effects.log: {He} laughs and leaves the jar. 'For when you are human again.'

events.text: Caught in a downpour, you end up sheltering under the same roof as {npc}. There is nothing to do but talk.

mem.note: told me their dreams in the rain

effects.log: By the time the rain stops, you have both said more than you meant to.
{npc} eats half of it and then tells you a joke so bad you both laugh until the rain stops.

events.text: {npc} tosses a wooden sword at your feet. 'I have been training. Let us see who is better now.'

ok.log: You win, narrowly. {npc} groans, then demands a rematch next year.

mem.note: let me win, or did they?

fail.log: {npc} wins and is unbearable about it for a week.

effects.log: 'Coward,' {npc} says, grinning. You share a meal instead.

events.text: A storm has torn the roof off {npc}'s shed and {he} is up there alone in the wind.

effects.log: Two hours, a hundred tiles, one near fall. You finish at dawn, laughing, soaked.

mem.note: fixed my roof in the storm

effects.log: It is not heroic, but {npc} does not fall. {He} remembers that.

events.text: You and {npc} reach for the same rare herb on a cliff ledge at the same time.

effects.log: {npc} looks surprised, then splits it with you anyway.

ok.log: You get it. {npc} laughs: 'Next one is mine.' You go herb-hunting together after that.

fail.log: {npc} gets it, then offers you half. You feel ashamed and grateful.

events.text: {npc} wakes you in the middle of the night to show you the moon. It is very big and very orange.

effects.log: You watch until it sets. Neither of you says anything, and it is perfect.
You grumble. Then you watch. Then you stop grumbling.

events.text: {npc} has tried to cook your favourite dish as a surprise. It is on fire.

effects.log: It is terrible. You eat every bite. {npc} knows exactly what that means.
The second try is almost edible. The kitchen is ruined. You both laugh until you cry.

events.text: {npc} asks you to teach {him} one sword form, just one, just for fun.

effects.log: {npc} is terrible, then less terrible. By the end of the summer {he} can do it beautifully.
It stops being a sword form almost at once. Nobody minds.

mem.note: danced with me in the yard

events.text: {npc} has a duel at dawn and needs a second to stand with {him}.

effects.log: You stand behind {npc} in the cold. {He} wins, barely, and does not let go of your arm afterwards.
It takes all night. At dawn {npc} does not go. {He} is alive, and not sure {he} forgives you.

events.text: {npc} plays a bamboo flute on the riverbank every evening. Tonight {he} waves you over.

effects.log: The tune is sad and beautiful. {He} plays it for you every evening after.
You sound like a goose. {He} laughs and teaches you anyway.

events.text: {npc} knows the name of every star and wants to teach someone before {he} forgets.

effects.log: A summer of night lessons. You never look at the sky the same way.
{He} laughs and uses your names from then on.

events.text: {npc} carves little wooden animals. {He} has carved one that looks exactly like you.

effects.log: {He} is delighted. You keep it on your shelf all your life.
Your first animal looks like a potato. {He} keeps it anyway.

events.text: A letter from {npc}, written in blood: 'The old mill, at dusk. You {grudge}.'

ok.log: At dusk you leave the mill alone. {npc} leaves it limping.

fail.log: {npc} has brought friends. You get away.

effects.log: You do not go. {npc} tells everyone you are a coward.

events.text: {npc}'s roof has collapsed in the storm, and {he} has nowhere else to go.

mem.note: took me in after the storm

effects.log: A crowded month, and a friend for life.
A week on the roof together.

mem.note: would not help after the storm

effects.log: {He} understands, but remembers.

events.text: {npc} wants to learn to defend {him}self and asks you for lessons.

effects.log: {He} learns fast. You learn too.
One trick, practised well.

mem.note: was too busy to teach me

effects.log: {He} finds another teacher.

events.text: {npc} is waiting on the rooftops as you walk home. 'You {grudge}. Come up here.'

ok.log: You win on the rooftops. {npc} retreats.

fail.log: {npc} wins. {He} leaves you on the roof.

effects.log: {npc} shouts after you. You keep walking.

events.text: A cold rain catches you on an open road, miles from any roof. {outfit} is soaked through in a moment, and you wrap {weapon_look} in oilcloth under your arm.

choices.text: Shelter under the eaves of a roadside shrine

effects.log: The shrine has a broken roof and a dry corner. You sleep there with the rain on the tiles and wake warm.
You walk through the rain until it gives up. Your boots squelch for two days; your legs remember it longer.

events.text: {npc} wants to go fishing, like you used to.

effects.log: Two fish, one sunburn, a hundred old stories.

mem.note: was too busy to go fishing

effects.log: {He} goes alone. {He} says it is fine.

events.text: You and {npc} argue about something that seems very important tonight.

effects.log: {He} apologises too. Neither of you remembers what it was about.
You were. It costs you a month of silence.

events.text: {npc} was hurt in a fight and is laid up for a month.

mem.note: visited me every day while I healed

effects.log: You bring soup and gossip. {He} heals faster.
You find them. You settle it quietly.

events.text: {npc} tells you a secret {he} has never told anyone.

effects.log: You take it to your grave.
Two secrets, one friendship, heavier and stronger.

events.text: {npc} is seeing someone who treats {him} badly. Everyone can see it but {him}.

effects.log: {He} is angry for a month, then thanks you.
When it ends, you are there.

events.text: {npc} insists on cooking you a new dish {he} invented.

effects.log: It is a crime against food. You smile.
The second version is edible. The third is good.

events.text: {npc} borrowed your sword a year ago and has not returned it.

effects.log: {He} is mortified and returns it polished.
{He} names it after you.

events.text: You and {npc} sit on a roof and remember the old days.

effects.log: The worst days make the best stories.
Plans, some foolish, all shared.

events.text: {npc} finds a grey hair and is devastated.

effects.log: Two grey friends, laughing.
{He} finds three more.

events.text: {npc} is jealous of your fame and says something cruel over drinks.

effects.log: {He} is ashamed in the morning.
Words fly. The friendship cools.

events.text: {npc} falls through the ice on a frozen river.

ok.log: You haul {him} out. Two frozen friends by the fire.

mem.note: went into the ice after me

fail.log: You both go in. You both get out, barely.

mem.note: fetched rope when I fell through the ice

effects.log: Faster than you knew you could. {He} lives.

events.text: Your rival {npc} sends you a gift: a whetstone, with a note: 'Keep your edge. I want a real fight.'

effects.log: A jar of good liniment. {He} laughs when {he} opens it.
Your blade has never been sharper.

events.text: The other soul finds you on a mountain peak, grey-haired this time. "So many lives," they say, setting down two cups of wine. "I counted. We have never once both died old. Shall we try it, this time? Together?"

effects.log: You shake on growing old. For once you both keep the promise. (+5 years)

choices.text: One last duel first, for old times

effects.log: A duel nobody watches, on a peak above the clouds. You both win. You both lose. You both laugh.

choices.text: Ask what they will do when it ends

effects.log: "It does not end," they say. "That is why it is worth doing well."

events.text: On the sea rocks an old fisher, {npc}, catches crabs with a bit of string and a stone, and has caught nine to your none.

effects.log: The trick is patience. {npc} says it in a way that makes it sound like a secret.

choices.text: Promise a dinner you can catch ten

ok.log: Ten crabs by sunset. {npc} cooks them all, and the dinner is yours.

fail.log: Two crabs by sunset. You cook dinner for {npc}, who eats it with great satisfaction.

events.text: A storm has smashed the rock pools, and {npc}'s favourite fishing rock is underwater. {npc} is sitting on the shore, sulking.

effects.log: A good flat rock round the point. {npc} catches eleven crabs on it and says the old one was better.
A day of hauling stones. The pool fills at high tide and keeps the crabs. {npc} calls it cheating, and uses it.

events.text: {npc} is too old for the rocks, and asks you to catch nine crabs, with string and a stone, and bring them to the hut.

ok.log: Nine by noon. {npc} cooks them, and says you have the trick at last.

fail.log: Four. {npc} says four is the number of a good student and cooks them anyway.

effects.log: {npc} catches one crab, slowly, and holds it up to you like a prize.

events.text: Your dog is old now and sleeps in the sun most of the day, but still stands up every time you come home.

choices.text: Sit with it in the sun

effects.log: An afternoon of nothing. It is enough.
It sniffs every tree like it is the first time.

events.text: Your cat leaves a dead rat on your pillow as a gift. It watches to see if you appreciate it.

effects.log: It purrs for an hour. Next day, two rats.

choices.text: Explain that rats are not gifts

effects.log: It stares at you with pity for your ignorance.

events.text: At midnight your fox sits in the moonlight, and for a moment it has more than one tail.

effects.log: It looks at you, and you could swear it winks.
It bows back. Nothing is ever quite ordinary again.

events.text: Your crane dances in the courtyard at dawn, long legs and wide wings. Passers-by stop to watch.

effects.log: You look ridiculous. You feel wonderful.

choices.text: Copy its steps in your footwork

effects.log: The crane's balance becomes your balance.

events.text: A cold night. Your companion sleeps pressed against you, warm and breathing slowly.

effects.log: You sleep better than you have in a year.
It listens better than most people.
